# 蘭盆獻供儀

**ID:** X1500
**Volume:** X74
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 禮懺部
**Byline:** 宋 元照重集
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1500

## Contributors
- 元照 (A000129)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X1500 in one fascicle is the standard Sòng-period liturgical manual for the *Yúlánpén* offering — the seventh-month-fifteenth-day rite that is the ritual practice grounded by the *Yúlánpén jīng* ([KR6i0364](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0364)). The witness is signed "餘杭沙門釋元照重集" ("re-compiled by the monk Yuánzhào of Yúháng") — the same Northern-Sòng *Lǜzōng* 律宗 revivalist responsible for *[Xīnjì 新記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0367)* (X372).

**Abstract**

[元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7)'s preface gives the textual genealogy of the Sòng *Yúlánpén* liturgy in unusual detail: "昔孤山法師甞作蘭盆禮讚文。三寶目連共為六位。啟白懺悔各四句而巳。仍用常途羅漢禮請之聲" — "in former times Dharma-master Gūshān ([孤山智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93) / Zhìyuán) composed a *Yúlánpén* liturgy in praise. The three jewels and Maudgalyāyana together constituted six liturgical positions, with four-line *qǐbái* 啟白 ("address-and-confession") and *chànhuǐ* 懺悔 ("repentance") texts at each position; the music continued to use the standard tunes for the *Arhat-invitation* (*luóhàn lǐqǐng zhī shēng* 羅漢禮請之聲)." [元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7) then notes that *Zhēnwù lǜshī* 真悟律師 had subsequently revised the rite for use as a "Tiānzhúzǔ" (Indian-patriarchal) ceremony, adding *qǐqǐng* 啟請 ("invitation") verses at the head and shifting [孤山智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93)'s four-line praise to the *tànfó* 歎佛 ("praising-the-buddha") position.

[元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7)'s own contribution is to note that the existing rite had omitted two crucial elements: (1) the *lùguò chénhuǐ* 露過陳悔 ("disclosure-of-faults and presentation-of-repentance") on behalf of the deceased, and (2) the *zhòuyuàn* 呪願 ("incantation-and-aspiration") that the parent sūtra prescribes immediately after the food-offering. He inserts both into the Sòng liturgy, restoring (in his view) the sūtra's prescribed sequence. The result is a comprehensive nine-section ceremonial: invitation, praise, food-offering, *zhòuyuàn* incantation, repentance, praise, transfer-of-merit, dedication, and conclusion.

Composition window: [元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7)'s mature Língzhīsì period, 1080–1116.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0364](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0364) (T685); commentary [KR6i0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365) (T1792); [元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7)'s sub-commentary [KR6i0367](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0367) (X372).
